root_cause.text: The mt7921 wireless driver failed to enforce an upper limit on station Association IDs (AID) within the station management functions, allowing values exceeding the firmware-supported threshold of 20 to be processed and trigger a crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch defines `MT7921_MAX_AID` as 20 in `mt7921.h` and adds validation checks `if (sta->aid > MT7921_MAX_AID)` returning `-ENOENT` in both `mt7921_mac_sta_add` and `mt7921_mac_sta_event` functions, directly addressing the CVE description stating that "Any station configured with an AID over 20 causes a firmware crash."
